semiconductor_relevance: High — NDS Taiwan specializes in providing dicing solutions and precision equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: NDS Taiwan is a leading provider of advanced dicing solutions for the semiconductor industry, offering high-precision dicing blades, dicing tapes, and auxiliary equipment. Established in 2009, the company focuses on enhancing production efficiency and precision for semiconductor manufacturers globally.

regional_presence.Taiwan: NDS Taiwan has a strategic presence in Taiwan, focusing on providing dicing solutions to local semiconductor manufacturers.
regional_presence.Japan: Dedicated technical teams are located in Japan to support regional customers.
regional_presence.China: NDS Taiwan also has teams in China to cater to the growing semiconductor market there.
